The grid improves the kernel-bound chat/osworld c5-c80 band. Adopt-vs-revert decision belongs to round 2 / the successor lane.

saturated_ceiling.note: KEPT inherited BY MEASUREMENT (2026-06-10, lane L8): the tp4 GT never reaches the saturated regime (max KV pressure 1.81 over 1043 turns vs build_saturated_ceiling threshold 2.5; builder would refuse) -> no own ceiling is derivable. The inherited H100-tp1 anchors bind ONLY as a clamp on swebench conc320 (pred pinned at 243.1 ms vs measured 83-90): they truncate the analytic-decode amplifier over-prediction rather than model a real tp4 plateau. Fix is the measured tp4 decode grid, not a ceiling.
